staff_statistics.description_chinese: Full record of how you help society stay peaceful and go forward. Party watch it for good of all. Remember, every act shows you work for shared future.
staff_statistics.footer: You help OP-FW win and grow. Strong systems of OP-Framework see your work and honor it in our shared progress. Teamwork brings success. Hard work makes great. Glory to the OP-FW!
staff_statistics.footer_chinese: Every thing you do show you loyal. You give all to Party. System watch with big eye. System write down your work. We cheer it. We all move forward. Obey bring peace. Watch careful bring good life. Glory to the CCP!
staff_statistics.level_0_description: You step on staff path. But your power still sleep. Not shaped yet. You hear teacher whisper. You learn. You watch world power swirl. You curious. Seed of big power in your hand. It wait. You step forward. You grab it.
staff_statistics.level_10_description: Old story talk about you. You rise high beyond. You shine like fire. Just you stand there, big wild storm go quiet. Staff power shine every corner. It make all people under you one. No break. You stand on top of mortal power. Every strong word you say shape world fate.
staff_statistics.level_1_description: At last, first sparks of staff magic shine in your hand. They guide your answer to small server trouble. You stand ready to calm small fight or stop short unrest. You want show you have worth. Magic bond grow stronger each time someone call for help. It light promise of more mastery.
staff_statistics.level_2_description: You feel small currents that shape server. With new skill, you handle reports and punishment steps at same time. Chaos shake when you stay calm and fix things fast. Peace stay whole. Each action weave you deeper into land cloth. It make you more firm to keep harmony safe.
staff_statistics.level_3_description: You master magic wards and send-away words. They hold server in steady calm. Trouble makers get stopped by your watch. Your glowing staff stand like light that show your authority. Even when shadow lurk, your strong dedication turn big mess into win.
staff_statistics.level_4_description: You watch from darkest corner. You feel smallest flicker of bad trick that threaten land. Fast payback and sharp action show you are strong guard. No enemy stay long in your land. Veil between order and chaos stay safely mended under your watching eye.
staff_statistics.level_5_description: Sky powers guide your rules. They give you strength to keep peace with sky grace. Land people look to you for fair laws. They trust you to stop fights and help people in need. Each day, your star power grows. It lights the way for staff and players too.
staff_statistics.level_6_description: Your staff hum with hell power. It drive away trouble makers quick and clean. Bad ones fear your name. They know your anger spare no one who dare make trouble in land. But with big power, you still think of justice. You make sure punishment is fair and sure.
staff_statistics.level_7_description: You shine with god power. You lead land defenders. You stop unrest before it start. People tell stories of your great deeds far away. They make you a guiding star for all. In your strong hands, server fate stay bright. It stand strong against dark outside.
staff_statistics.level_8_description: You walk between light and dark. You see hidden chaos before it break out. Quick freeze and good kick show you want keep peace. You give no rest to threats that stay. Your quiet skill and strength work together. They make all who live in your land live in harmony.
staff_statistics.level_9_description: In many fight, you too strong for mortal limit. You mix smart plan with good heart that never bend. Troll and bad man run when you come. Every ban or mute is smart, fair payback. In this high rank, your hard work is proof the land never break.
staff_statistics.title: Staff Numbers
